content: Fixed conditions for the abduction: under the same data distribution, CIFAR-10 is divided into CIFAR-10a and CIFAR-10b (25,000 training images each, 2,500 per class); winning tickets are generated using CIFAR-10a and evaluated on CIFAR-10b; models are ResNet50; comparisons are against random tickets and CIFAR-10b winning tickets; performance is measured at extreme pruning fractions; error bars represent mean ± standard deviation across six random seeds.
